newsitem.title: USA: ARCO to lease Thrifty's Calif. gas stations.
newsitem.headline: ARCO to lease Thrifty's Calif. gas stations.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co (ARCO) announced Monday it entered a long-term agreement with Thrifty Oil Co. to lease more than 260 of its California retail gasoline outlets and convenience stores.
Terms of the agreement, which have been approved by the board of directors of both companies, were not released.
Thrifty Oil Co. is a privately held independent retail marketer, headquartered in Downey, CA.

The deal means ARCO will increase its California branded retail locations to more than 1,275 facilities, with more than 1,700 retail outlets in five Western states -- Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada and Arizona.
ARCO will operate most of the Thrifty locations as franchises through its company owned and operated subsidiary Prestige Stations, Inc. (PSI) and some through dealers.
Current supply arrangements for Thrifty outlets will remain in effect, the company said.
Thrifty is one of ARCO's largest dealers, and 44 of the roughly 260 locations have been ARCO branded for years, the company said.
Unbranded locations are expected to become branded by July 1, with renovations at convenience stores slated for completion within five years.

When the remaining Thrifty stores become branded ARCO's monthly volumes per site are expected to be comparable to ARCO's existing throughput of approximately 225,000 gallons. ((David Brinkerhoff, Los Angelese bureau +1 213 380 2014))
